==English==

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:der|frm:explorer|tree=1}}
From {{der|en|frm|explorer}}, from {{der|en|la|explōrō|explōrāre|to investigate, search out}}, itself said to be originally a hunters' term meaning "to set up a loud cry", from {{m|la|ex-||out}} + {{m|la|plōrō|plōrāre|to cry}}, but the second element is also explained as "to make to flow" (from {{m|la|pluō|pluere|to flow}}).<ref name="Etymonline">{{R:Etymonline}}</ref> Displaced native {{noncog|ang|rāsian}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{enPR|ĭksplôʹ|a=RP}}, {{IPA|en|/ɪkˈsplɔː/}}
* {{enPR|ĭksplôrʹ|a=GenAm}}, {{IPA|en|/ɪkˈsploɹ/}}
* {{enPR|ĭksplōrʹ|a=rhotic,non-horse-hoarse}}, {{IPA|en|/ɪkˈsplo(ː)ɹ/}}
* {{IPA|en|/ɪkˈsploə/|a=non-rhotic,non-horse-hoarse}}
* {{audio|en|En-us-explore.ogg|a=US}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɔː(ɹ)|s=2}}
* {{hyphenation|en|ex|plore}}

===Verb===
{{wikidata lexeme|L112}}
{{en-verb}}

# {{lb|en|intransitive|obsolete}} To [[seek]] for something or after someone.
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[examine]] or [[investigate]] something [[systematically]].
#: {{ux|en|The committee has been '''exploring''' alternative solutions to the problem at hand.}}
#* {{quote-journal|en|year=2013|month=May-June|author=[http://www.americanscientist.org/authors/detail/katie-l-burke Katie L. Burke]
|title=[http://www.americanscientist.org/issues/pub/2013/3/in-the-news-45 In the News]
|volume=101|issue=3|page=193|magazine=w:American Scientist
|passage=Bats host many high-profile viruses that can infect humans, including severe acute respiratory syndrome and Ebola. A recent study '''explored''' the ecological variables that may contribute to bats’ propensity to harbor such zoonotic diseases by comparing them with another order of common reservoir hosts: rodents.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To [[travel]] somewhere in search of [[discovery]].
#: {{ux|en|It was around that time that the expedition began '''exploring''' the Arctic Circle.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive|medicine}} To examine [[diagnostically]].
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To (seek) [[experience]] [[first hand]].
#: {{ux|en|It is normal for a boy of this age to be '''exploring''' his sexuality.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To be engaged exploring in any of the above senses.
#: {{ux|en|He was too busy '''exploring''' to notice his son needed his guidance.}}
# {{lb|en|intransitive}} To [[wander]] without any particular [[aim]] or [[purpose]].
#: {{ux|en|The boys '''explored''' all around till cold and hunger drove them back to the campfire one by one.}}
#* {{RQ:Marshall Squire's Daughter|A Court Ball|9|They stayed together during three dances, went out on to the terrace, '''explored''' wherever they were permitted to '''explore''', paid two visits to the buffet, and enjoyed themselves much in the same way as if they had been school-children surreptitiously breaking loose from an assembly of grown-ups.}}
# {{lb|en|transitive}} To seek sexual [[variety]], to [[sow one's wild oats]].
